ops.title: Adopt the fleet process-cap test harness (Taskfile and release.yml run bare go test)
ops.description: Taskfile's test task runs bare `go test -race -count=1 ./...` with no process-cap wrapper, and the repo ships no scripts/test.sh; release.yml does the same. On a dev machine, daemonkit-style self-exec spawn tests make bare go test a fork bomb (daemonkit AGENTS.md, Testing section; 2026-06-24 mount-holder incident). Port daemonkit's scripts/test.sh — RLIMIT_NPROC soft cap = uid procs + 400 headroom; note a flat ulimit -u 500 fails instantly on a machine already carrying ~950 procs — and point Taskfile plus the CI/release workflows at it. Found during the v0.27.3 repin (2026-07-26): every local verification run had to hand-roll the cap formula. cookiesync is the last of the 12 downstreams without the harness.

ops.text: scripts/test.sh with the RLIMIT_NPROC cap exists and Taskfile test routes through it
CI and release workflows run tests via the harness
